image_purpose: Create a polished bedroom mirror selfie with a clearly adult original subject and refined athletic styling.

prompt.project_info: 9:16 photorealistic raw-phone mirror selfie adapted from the source prompt and folder context.
prompt.main_subject: Clearly adult original woman with heart-shaped facial structure, hazel-green eyes, natural fair-to-olive skin texture, long dark hair, a neutral pout and athletic lean build; wearing a deep-pink ribbed cotton tank top and opaque heather-gray athletic shorts with white trim.
